@astrojs/check.necessity: Validates Astro templates and embedded TypeScript.

@axe-core/playwright.necessity: Runs accessibility assertions in browser evidence tests.

@cloudflare/workers-oauth-provider.necessity: Maintained Workers OAuth server provides PKCE, hashed tokens, audience binding and refresh rotation independently from user login.

@cloudflare/workers-types.necessity: Provides Cloudflare Worker and Durable Object runtime types for the independently typechecked installer package.

@eslint/js.necessity: Provides supported ESLint flat recommended configuration.

@expressive-code/plugin-line-numbers.necessity: Adds line-number gutters to docs and blog code blocks.

@modelcontextprotocol/client.necessity: Real modern MCP client used to verify Connector protocol compatibility.

@modelcontextprotocol/sdk.necessity: Runs the disposable HTTPS MCP service and notification fixture for ACP URL completion verification.

@modelcontextprotocol/server.necessity: Official stateless MCP protocol server with legacy client compatibility for the SAM Connector.

@playwright/test.necessity: Executes browser evidence and screenshot checks.

@storybook/addon-docs.necessity: Builds Storybook documentation pages for components.

@storybook/react.necessity: Provides the React renderer for Storybook.

@storybook/react-vite.necessity: Provides Vite integration for React Storybook.

@tailwindcss/vite.necessity: Compiles Tailwind CSS through Vite builds.

@tanstack/query-persist-client-core.necessity: Persists an allowlisted slice of the TanStack Query cache so a reload paints from cache instead of an empty state. Loaded via dynamic import for signed-in sessions only.

@types/better-sqlite3.necessity: Types for the project-data test SQLite engine; same version the API worker tests use.

@types/node.necessity: Types for node:crypto, which project-data's archive hashing uses under the Worker's nodejs_compat; same catalog version as the root.

@typescript-eslint/parser.necessity: Parses TypeScript for ESLint rules and fixtures.

@valibot/to-json-schema.necessity: Exports operation input schemas as JSON Schema for shared MCP and HTTP adapters.

@vitest/coverage-v8.necessity: Generates V8 coverage for workspace gates.

astro.necessity: Compiles the shared brand Astro components (packages/ui/src/brand) into the installer's static pages and checks them; same pinned version the marketing site already uses.

better-sqlite3.necessity: Real SQLite engine for project-data unit tests of Durable Object SQL; already the API worker's test engine at the same version.

diff.necessity: Builds unified diffs for Artifacts repository compare views in repo-hosting; moved from the API worker at the same version.

drizzle-orm.necessity: Defines the D1 schema in worker-core; already the API worker ORM at the same pinned version.

eslint.necessity: Runs authoritative lint and local rule fixtures.

eslint-plugin-astro.necessity: Parses and lints tracked Astro templates.

eslint-plugin-react-hooks.necessity: Preserves existing React Hooks lint findings.

fake-indexeddb.necessity: In-memory IndexedDB for tests of the query-cache persister; jsdom provides no IndexedDB implementation.

fast-check.necessity: Property-based generator for the scheduler lifecycle simulation in scheduler-core; already the API worker's test dependency at the same pinned version.

idb-keyval.necessity: IndexedDB backing store for the persisted query cache. Chosen over localStorage so it cannot evict the library-cache index, which already needs its own LRU within the ~5 MB localStorage budget.

isomorphic-git.necessity: Reads Artifacts-backed Git repositories in memory for repo-hosting's repository browser; moved from the API worker at the same version.

jose.necessity: Signs GitHub App JWTs in repo-hosting; the API worker uses the same catalog version for its own JWTs.

oxlint.necessity: Measures native lint findings in shadow mode.

postal-mime.necessity: Parses inbound RFC 5322/MIME email for agent email triggers (packages/agent-email, reached from the API Worker email() handler); zero dependencies and the parser Cloudflare documents for Email Workers.

sharp.necessity: Downscales marketing feature screenshots and writes their WebP siblings (apps/www optimize:features).

storybook.necessity: Provides the Storybook build and test CLI.

tsx.necessity: Runs the deterministic Astro validation wrapper.

typescript-eslint.necessity: Provides supported ESLint flat TypeScript configuration.

uplot.necessity: Canvas time-series charts for the session resource timeline; handles tens of thousands of points with zoom and synced cursors in ~23 KB gzipped, loaded only when Resources opens.

valibot.necessity: Runtime JSON boundary validation in worker-core and scheduler-core; already used by shared and the API worker at the same catalog version.

vitest.necessity: Runs local plugin and quality checker fixtures.

wrangler.necessity: Provides the lockfile-pinned Cloudflare Pages deployment executable for the marketing workspace.

yaml.necessity: Structurally parses GitHub workflow contracts in security regression tests.

golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck.necessity: Pins the official govulncheck CLI used by the diff-local Go vulnerability gate.

golang.org/x/sys.necessity: Uses unix.Openat and unix.Mkdirat for pinned-directory workspace ownership initialization without symlink traversal on Linux and Darwin. Promotes the existing pinned v0.48.0 indirect module to direct use; no version or resolved module change.
